scripts.optimize:images:
echo "To optimize images, run one of the following locally:
  1) npx imagemin-cli public/images/* --out-dir=public/images/optimized
  2) npx sharp-cli --verbose public/images/* --output public/images/optimized
  3) Install cwebp and run: for f in public/images/*.png; do cwebp -q 80 "$f" -o "${f%.*}.webp"; done"
